format.timing_basis: speech at 166.0 wpm (Emily's measured pace in her edit). Retime every shot to the real clips.

competitor_cut_analysis.source: 44 Meta Ad Library video ads, measured 2026-09-26 (session-chat/2026-09-25_emily-character-kie.session.md)
competitor_cut_analysis.closest_niche: The Mobile Home Guys: 0-4 cuts per ad, handheld selfie walk-and-talk single takes

vertical_refs_scene_detect.method: ffmpeg scene detect at 0.3, 2026-09-27; undercounts b-roll with similar colour and dissolves

attention: Meta: feed content is recalled after 0.25 s, so the first frame must already show him and the house
TikTok: 63%+ of highest-CTR videos land the key message in the first 3 s
one focal action per shot (working-memory limit)
2-3 keyword captions help recall; full subtitles that repeat the voice hurt it (Mayer)

rules: Omni makes one continuous take per clip: every cut is made in the edit
a new camera angle of him (from behind, from the side) needs its own generation: a start image, then a short Omni clip with no dialogue
loop lines (OPEN / CLOSE) on his face; payload on b-roll; the trust line (CLOSE B) never cuts away
object b-roll shows objects and places only, no other people, and matches the words
punch-in = crop the same take to 131% on a key phrase
the voice runs unbroken under every cut

cuts.note: above the measured median of 2.97 because of the 3-shot furniture/bed/closet burst the user asked for
